[head=1][color=#e8b04b]Hullrot: Eclipsion[/color][/head]
Welcome. This is a roleplay server set in the [bold]Taypan asteroid belt[/bold], and every player here helps shape its story.
Before anything else, know that this is [bold]not[/bold] a deathmatch server. What you do matters. Your choices, your words, and the people you meet all leave a mark on the world. Play your character honestly, stay in the moment, and treat the setting as a place you live in rather than a scoreboard you climb.
[head=2][color=#e8b04b]What kind of place this is[/color][/head]
Taypan is harsh and unforgiving. You will lose fights, you will die, and sometimes you will lose gear you cared about. That is part of the experience, not a sign you did something wrong. Take the loss, adapt, and keep the story moving.
Conflict belongs here too. Betrayal, sabotage, and destruction can all create moments people remember for a long time. But the best moments come from variety. Blowing up the same reactor or killing the same enemy every round turns a rich world into a repetitive grind, so look for the choice that makes a better story instead of the fastest kill.
Out here in the belt, a few things are worth remembering:
- A living prisoner opens more doors than a dead enemy. - A conversation can be more memorable than a firefight. - Your character's decisions ripple out and affect everyone around them.
[head=2][color=#e8b04b]Read the rules before you play[/color][/head]
The [textlink="Roleplay Rules" link="RoleplayRules"] are short, and they are the only ones you have to read before your first round. They cover mutiny, round removal, and where the line sits on in-character prejudice.
[head=2][color=#e8b04b]Then find your footing[/color][/head]
Eclipsion has its own history, factions, politics, and custom systems, and none of it will match what you know from standard Space Station 14. You do not need to learn it all first. Three pages will carry your first round:
- [textlink="Start Here: Your First Round" link="GettingStarted"] — what to pick, where to go, what not to touch. - [textlink="Factions" link="Factions"] — who is fighting, and which side suits you. - [textlink="Custom Controls and Combat Basics" link="Tutorial"] — the controls this server changed.
Everything deeper — the [textlink="Lore" link="Lore"], the economy, ships, and ship weapons — is in the Guidebook when you want it. Open it any time with [color=#6ab7d6][bold]Numpad 0[/bold][/color], or the [bold]Guidebook[/bold] button in the game menu.
Take your time, and become part of the story of Taypan.
